description: A layout manager that arranges panes into dockable areas (top, left, center, right, bottom) and floating overlays. Supports drag-and-drop docking, tab grouping, close and float actions.

parameters.name: OnLayoutChanged
parameters.description: Fires whenever the layout changes (dock, float, close, reorder).

parameters.name: OnPaneClose
parameters.description: Template used to render each when is set.

parameters.name: OnPaneDock
parameters.description: Fires when a pane is docked back from floating.

parameters.name: OnPaneFloat
parameters.description: Fires when a pane is floated.

parameters.name: PaneTemplate
parameters.description: Template used to render each DockPane when Items is set.
